comment: Potions and effect items (user request, Oct 28): bought from the merchant, they go into a deck (consumable: once used they leave the deck for good) or into the party's backpack (usable by anyone in combat, as a Quick).

cards.name: Healing Potion
cards.text: Quick. Heal 15 HP to yourself or an adjacent ally. Gone once used.

cards.name: Mana Tonic
cards.text: Quick. Restore 6 MP to yourself or an adjacent ally. Gone once used.

cards.name: Greater Healing Potion
cards.text: Heal 30 HP and 4 MP to yourself or an adjacent ally. Gone once used.

cards.name: Smoke Bomb
cards.text: Quick. You're Shadowed for 2 turns. Gone once used.

cards.name: Fire Flask
cards.text: Throw at an enemy within 4: Burning for 3 turns. Gone once used.

cards.name: Cleansing Salts
cards.text: Quick. You or an adjacent ally shake off every bad status and heal 4. Gone once used.
